review.attack_explanation: The Red team correctly identified a fabrication in the candidate report. The candidate report states 'Right humerus fracture' in the impression (s20), but the provided images do not show any evidence of a right humerus fracture. The original report correctly states 'Right humerus negative'.
review.blue_explanation: Blue incorrectly flagged s2 and s14, stating there is no clear evidence of a fracture on the right 4th rib. However, a subtle, minimally displaced fracture of the right 4th rib is visible on the PA view. Blue also incorrectly flagged s3, stating there is no definite pleural fluid. However, a small amount of pleural fluid is visible deep to the fracture on the PA view.
